plastic-scm.cmConfiguration.cmPath.markdownDescription: Specifies a given `cm` executable that is not in your `PATH` environment variable.

plastic-scm.cmConfiguration.millisToWait.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait for the `cm shell` to be up before disabling the extension. In some systems, shell initialization might be slow.

plastic-scm.cmConfiguration.millisToStop.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait for the `cm shell` to exit when it has to stop or restart. This might prevent aborting commands in the middle of their execution.

plastic-scm.cmConfiguration.millisComman.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait for a single `cm` command to complete. A command that exceeds this is abandoned and the `cm shell` is restarted, because its output can no longer be matched to a command. `0` means no limit.

plastic-scm.ignoredDirectories.markdownDescription: Top-level directory names whose changes never trigger an automatic refresh. Unity and Unreal rewrite these constantly, and watching them makes the status refresh run continuously without ever showing a change.

plastic-scm.consolidateUnrealOneFilePerA.markdownDescription: By default, the plugin will consolidate all __ExternalActors__ and __ExternalObjects__ changes (from Unreal Engine's One File Per Actor system) into a single entry in the Dirty Unreal Levels group.

plastic-scm.autorefresh.markdownDescription: Autorefresh workspace status when something changes.

plastic-scm.decorations.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether or not file decorations are enabled.

plastic-scm.discardPrivateChangesToTrash.markdownDescription: Controls whether discarding private (untracked) items moves them to the Recycle Bin (Windows) or Trash (macOS, Linux) instead of deleting them permanently. `cm` cannot undo a private item, so discarding one always means deleting it from disk.

plastic-scm.history.pageSize.markdownDescription: Changesets fetched per branch on each page of the Plastic SCM Graph view. Each page is one `cm find` round trip to the server, and the view loads the current branch and its parent branch separately.

enumDescriptions: One list of files sorted by path.
plastic-scm.reviews.fileLayout.markdownDescription: How Plastic Reviews lists changed files.

plastic-scm.reviews.updateCheckInterval.markdownDescription: Seconds between two checks for changes in Plastic Reviews: the open review, whatever is on screen, and the review queue while the Reviews view is visible. The shortest interval is 15 seconds; `0` turns the checks off.

plastic-scm.reviews.notifyUpdates.markdownDescription: Show a notification when a check finds new comments from someone else, new changesets or a new status in the open review. With this off, the **Review updated** row and **Load Updates** still show them.

plastic-scm.reviews.commentWrites.markdownDescription: Allows posting comments and replies, editing and deleting your own comments, adding yourself as a reviewer and setting your own review status, through `cm` as the user `cm` is signed in as. Needs Unity Version Control client 11.0.16.10512 or newer and a trusted workspace.

plastic-scm.reviews.experimentalPosting.markdownDeprecationMessage: **Deprecated:** use `#plastic-scm.reviews.commentWrites#` instead. This setting only counts where `commentWrites` is not set.
